_why: The oldest relavoi-backend this operator console can run against, as the
scripts/vercel-ignore-build.mjs is wired in as this project's Vercel
Ignored Build Step and skips a production build while the live backend is
behind this number, so the console can never go live ahead of the API it
Raise it in the same commit as the code that needs the newer backend, and
only to a number relavoi-backend has already shipped: the backend's own
test suite fails if this asks for a version that does not exist, because a
build that waits for a version nobody will ever serve waits for ever and
Vercel records it as CANCELED rather than failed.
Lowering it is not a rollback. A build already skipped stays skipped until
something triggers it again: a push, or the backend deploy script poking
